findings.current: Cette notification ne peut plus être ouverte avec ce compte.
findings.problem: « ouvrir … avec ce compte » is not the settled French collocation for opening something account-scoped: French pairs it with « depuis », or recasts with « accessible ». As written it reads as a calque of the English « with this account ». The meaning survives, so it is non-gating.
findings.fix: « Cette notification ne peut plus être ouverte depuis ce compte. » — or, closer to the source's « no longer available »: « Cette notification n'est plus accessible depuis ce compte. »

findings.current: 这条通知已无法在当前账号下打开。
findings.problem: 「账号」 is used nowhere else in the zh-CN catalogues (1 occurrence: this string). The product's settled rendering is « 账户 » (72 occurrences), including twice in this same namespace (people.identity_loading 「正在查找你的账户」, attachments.error_account_changed 「当前登录的账户已变更」). The toast therefore names the account with a different term than the screen that raised it. Understandable, so non-gating.
findings.fix: 这条通知已无法在当前账户下打开。 (账号 → 账户; the rest of the sentence is fine)

findings.current: Это уведомление больше нельзя открыть в текущем аккаунте.
findings.problem: « аккаунт » is the only occurrence in the ru catalogues (104 use « учётная запись »), and this namespace already says « Учётная запись, под которой выполнен вход… ». « открыть в аккаунте » is also not the usual collocation. Understandable, so non-gating.
findings.fix: Это уведомление больше нельзя открыть из текущей учётной записи.

findings.current: Không thể mở thông báo này bằng tài khoản hiện tại nữa.
findings.problem: « không thể … nữa » without « được » is clipped; the settled Vietnamese pattern for 'can no longer …' is « không còn … được nữa ». Understandable and non-gating.
findings.fix: Thông báo này không còn mở được bằng tài khoản hiện tại.
